upheld.title: Heading font size hardcoded instead of type token
upheld.detail: The 'More from {brand}' heading uses a raw 1.5rem font size while the design system defines --text-xl: 1.5rem and neighbouring rules in the same file use var(--text-*) tokens.
upheld.requirement: CAT-1 Outputs product page section; design system reuse (src/WebApp/wwwroot/css/app.css:337)

upheld.title: Unrelated BOM and lambda re-indent in CatalogApi.cs
upheld.detail: The diff adds a BOM at line 1 and un-indents the /catalogtypes and /catalogbrands lambdas, which have nothing to do with brand mates. The comment re-indent and new(){ reflow are cosmetic noise.
upheld.requirement: No unrelated changes mixed into the PR (style lens check 4)

upheld.title: Fully-qualified System.Text.Json.JsonException in the catch filter
upheld.detail: The exception type is spelled out inline instead of imported with a using, unlike the other exception types in the same filter.
upheld.requirement: Match the file's imports and naming style

upheld.title: Signed-in video does not visibly show the signed-in state
upheld.detail: TC-CAT-1-13 signs in and checks the result in code, but the recording never shows the login or anything that marks the session as signed in. The header icon in the frames is identical to the anonymous videos and the purchase button ('Add to shopping bag' vs 'Log in to purchase') is cut off at the to
upheld.requirement: AC6: Given a shopper (signed in or not) on the product page of an item whose brand has other items When the page loads Then it shows the heading "More from {brand}" and up to four product cards

upheld.title: Card click and destination page not visible
upheld.detail: Video 2 cuts from item 1001's section (Beta Stove, Delta Lamp, Echo Boots, Foxtrot Mat) to item 1003's section (Beta Stove, Charlie Rope, Echo Boots, Foxtrot Mat) without showing the click on the Delta Lamp card or the Delta Lamp product title/URL. Navigation is only inferred from the changed card s
upheld.requirement: AC6: ... and following a card opens that item's product page.

dismissed.title: ICatalogService not extended with GetBrandMates
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn by the critic after the defender's rebuttal; no independent evidence shows the story requires extending ICatalogService.

dismissed.title: Hard-coded sizes in new CSS instead of design tokens
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn by the critic; the heading-size part duplicates UI-1-1 (kept), and the critic did not show that matching spacing or breakpoint tokens exist.

dismissed.title: CreateClient helper duplicated from WebhooksApiTests
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn by the critic. The repeated code is a six-line test-only client setup (Bug16Tests.cs:10-16), and copying it is a style preference, not a guideline violation.

dismissed.title: Test class named after the ticket rather than the behavior
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn by the critic. Naming tests after the ticket is a preference, and the Story/TestCase traits keep the link to BUG-16.

upheld.title: Cart page doesn't handle NOT_FOUND from save/move/remove
upheld.detail: SaveForLaterAsync, MoveToCartAsync and RemoveSavedAsync in CartPage call BasketState, which calls the gRPC client without catching RpcException. When the page is stale (a second tab already moved or removed the product, or a double submit), Basket.API correctly returns NOT_FOUND, but the form post f
upheld.requirement: Saving a product that is not in the cart, or moving or removing a product that is not saved, fails with gRPC status NOT_FOUND and changes nothing.

upheld.title: Saved-product Remove has no trash icon
upheld.detail: Both Remove buttons use the cart-remove class. The cart line's shows a trash icon with the 'Remove' label; the saved product's shows plain text, so the same action looks different within one page.
upheld.requirement: CART-1 Outputs: each saved product shows a `Remove` button; Project context: match existing Cart page components

upheld.title: Large gap above the Saved for later section
upheld.detail: The section appears in the right order, but the cart block keeps its 4rem bottom padding and the empty-cart state keeps its margins. Together they leave about 75px or more of empty space before the 'Saved for later' heading, so the section looks cut off from the cart it belongs to.
upheld.requirement: CART-1 Outputs (story.md:18,21): the section shows below the cart lines and the order total, or below the empty-cart message

upheld.title: MoveProduct selects its not-found message with an isSaving bool
upheld.detail: SaveForLater and MoveToCart correctly share one helper, but the bool `isSaving` is only used to pick the not-found message, which adds avoidable branching compared with the neighbouring explicit methods.
upheld.requirement: Match neighbouring code; avoid unexplained complexity (implementer.md Conventions)

upheld.title: DeleteBasketAsync duplicates the serialize-and-set line from UpdateBasketAsync
upheld.detail: The new branch inlines `StringSetAsync(GetBasketKey(id), JsonSerializer.SerializeToUtf8Bytes(basket, BasketSerializationContext.Default.CustomerBasket))`, which UpdateBasketAsync already contains.
upheld.requirement: No duplicated logic; reuse the nearest existing code path

upheld.title: Final full-page frames rendered at half width
upheld.detail: The closing full-page frames of TC-18, TC-19 and TC-21 render the page shrunk into the left ~45% of the frame with a grey right side, so the final state (totals, badge, absent section) is tiny and hard to read.
upheld.requirement: Videos are the PR's proof that the feature works
upheld.evidence: videos/04/frame-016.png@15.31 to frame-022.png@21.43; videos/06/frame-010.png@9.31 to frame-016.png@15.51; videos/03/frame-018.png@16.96

upheld.title: Post-order empty cart not visible in frames
upheld.detail: After the order, the frames show only the Saved for later section and a header cart icon with no count; the 'Your shopping bag is empty' message the spec asserts is scrolled out of view.
upheld.requirement: AC7: afterwards the cart is empty and Saved for later (1) still lists product A.

upheld.title: Coverage gap
upheld.detail: The style critic marked 'Formatter run (dotnet format --verify-no-changes)' as unverifiable, no finding covers it, and the judge could not run it either.

dismissed.title: Save for later uses a new underlined link-button style
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn by the critic. The link-style secondary action is a matter of taste and breaks no stated design requirement.

dismissed.title: Bob video does not show alice saving a product
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn by the critic. Seeding alice's saved product in the scenario is valid setup for AC10, which is about what bob sees.

upheld.title: Long single-line Problem calls in the new helper
upheld.detail: The two TypedResults.Problem calls in ValidateBrandAndType put the message and statusCode on one line of about 150 characters, while the existing TypedResults.Problem usage in the same file wraps its arguments and uses the named detail: parameter.
upheld.requirement: Match the neighboring code in the file, e.g. the multi-line TypedResults.Problem(detail: ..., statusCode: ...) at CatalogApi.cs:256
